reason: Prevent a transient open-PR snapshot fence change from becoming a persistent trusted-collision blocker while preserving the first fail-closed evaluation, the literal severity-2 material-collision preflight, and all substantive HOLD conditions.

changes.reason: Boundedly recompute trusted collision preflight when snapshot_changed_during_evaluation is present, no collision reaches the configured fail threshold, there are no inspection errors, and main/candidate SHAs remained stable. The trusted preflight invocation retains the literal --fail-on-severity 2 declaration so the public-safe contract can independently prove material collisions remain blocking. Severity-1 awareness overlaps remain observable but do not become a false material blocker solely because the open-PR inventory changed mid-scan. Preserve per-attempt reports and fail after three attempts or immediately on material conditions.

exclusions: No collision severity threshold is weakened; trusted preflight remains literal fail-on-severity 2.
No failed evaluation is converted to PASS; each retry runs the collision agent again against fresh provider state.
Any collision at or above severity 2, inspection error, provider read failure, changed main SHA, or changed candidate SHA remains fail-closed.
Retry count is bounded to three evaluations; exhaustion remains failure.
Severity-1 awareness remains recorded in collision reports and repair proposals.
No D3, credential, provider-write, payout, release, or money-movement authority is added.
